missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Двор' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Тихий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'наш' marks possession.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Во дворе' uses the prepositional form 'дворе' after 'во'. The vowel in the preposition appears before the consonant cluster, a fixed locative phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Двор' is accusative after 'во', marking motion into the yard. The inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Двора' is the genitive singular required by 'посреди'. The masculine ending '-а' marks the location in the middle of something.

missions.phrase: Мы вышли из двора на улицу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Двора' is the genitive singular after 'из', marking motion out of the yard. The masculine ending is '-а'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Двору' is the dative singular after 'к', marking motion toward the yard. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'Двором' is the instrumental singular after 'за', marking position behind the yard. 'Нашим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Двор' is the accusative direct object of 'знаю'. As an inanimate masculine noun it keeps the nominative form. 'Этот' points to a specific yard.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Дворах' is the prepositional plural after 'во', describing many yards. 'Во всех' adds the universal scope to this locative phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Дворами' is the instrumental plural after 'между', marking position among the yards. The ending '-ами' is standard for masculine plurals.
